lead.headline: Bears Host Buccaneers on Sunday Night Football, Chasing 7-2
lead.subhead: Chicago (6-2) seeks a fourth straight win and a sixth in seven games against Tampa Bay (3-5) at Soldier Field, 7:20 PM CT on NBC. The league's top two rushing offenses meet top-four run defenses. Monangai, Stevenson and Malik Muhammad II are questionable; Tampa's Yaya Diaby is out.

articles.hed: Swift Leads the NFL in Rushing Touchdowns
articles.body: D'Andre Swift has 10 rushing scores after three against Seattle, the most in the league, and the Bears have 17 rushing touchdowns through eight games. Tampa Bay has held each of its last seven opponents under 100 rushing yards and blanked Atlanta 16-0 last week without completing a pass.

articles.hed: Walker Comes Back to Stop Cortes Acosta
articles.body: Johnny Walker took last night's heavyweight main event on short notice and knocked out Waldo Cortes Acosta at 2:27 of round 3 with a question-mark kick and follow-up punches, his second straight finish since moving up. Tatiana Suarez also stayed in the strawweight title mix with a decision over Virna Jandiroba.

openingBell.title: The Opening Bell
openingBell.intro: Sunday, the day of the Sun. Four counts in, four hold, four out, four hold. The Sun rewards what you make visible: show up, shine, and let the work be seen.

breathing.title: Box Breathing — 4 · 4 · 4 · 4

phases.label: INHALE
phases.cue: Draw in through the nose — even, quiet, full.

phases.label: HOLD
phases.cue: Stillness at the top. No strain. Own the pause.

phases.label: HOLD
phases.cue: Empty and steady. Reset the line.

breathing.close: Four rounds squares the mind. Eyes open. Shoulders down. Body next. Then go own Sunday.

mindset.hed: Show Up When the Lights Are On
mindset.body: Johnny Walker was losing after two rounds and still found the kick that ended the night. The Bears have three straight wins and another prime-time stage tonight. Nobody waits for a softer schedule. Put in one real block before kickoff, then go watch Chicago chase 7-2. Competitive. Unbeatable. Always rising. fall down 7 stand up 8.

bodyOpener.title: 3-Minute Opener
bodyOpener.note: Sunday, the day of the Sun: run this right after Morning Charge. Dawn is still chilly (about 38°, feels near 31°) even with clear skies, so keep the RipStick finisher indoors this morning. By kickoff it should be in the 50s. Strong, smooth reps.

moves.name: Push-ups
moves.body: Crisp reps, chest to floor. If you hit 30 early, hold high plank until the minute mark.

moves.name: Plank
moves.body: Elbows or hands. Ribs down, glutes on. Breathe slow.

moves.name: RipStick finisher
moves.body: Dom's RipStick (RipRight): hold sticks at chest → inhale and pull apart as wide as possible → with bands open, exhale and push arms straight out while keeping them apart (dynamic isometrics / Push-Pulls). Smooth continuous reps for the remaining time.

items.hed: Apple's first touchscreen MacBook Pro is in stores
items.body: The new 14- and 16-inch MacBook Pros pair a tandem OLED PROLED XDR display with M5 Pro and M5 Max chips, and they put a Dynamic Island on the Mac for the first time. Availability began Friday after late-October pre-orders.

items.hed: OpenAI teams with Hacktron to hunt its own bugs
items.body: OpenAI is partnering with security firm Hacktron to probe how its systems talk to third-party services. Engineers from both sides will pick high-priority tests, and Hacktron gets wider access to frontier models through the Daybreak Red program.

FlashProve is a research prototype that lets anyone check an AI reply really came from the model a provider claims, without handing over the weights. Anthropic published the code, a technical report and formal proofs; it is not running inside Claude yet.

items.hed: Wemby scores 29 in 24 minutes as Spurs run it to eight straight
items.body: San Antonio blew out Portland 125-103. Victor Wembanyama needed only 13 shots (9 of 13) for 29 points before sitting the fourth. The Spurs are 8-2 and never trailed.

items.hed: Curry drops 41 as Warriors outlast Magic in OT
items.body: Stephen Curry scored 41 and Golden State beat Orlando 126-119 in overtime to move to 7-3. Franz Wagner had 30 and 11 assists in the loss.
Shai Gilgeous-Alexander scored 30 without playing the fourth quarter. Washington's 75 points were the lowest total of the NBA season. Oklahoma City is also 8-2.

items.hed: Bears host Bucs in the last of three straight prime-time games
items.body: Chicago (6-2) seeks a fourth straight win tonight at Soldier Field after beating the Patriots and Seahawks. Tampa Bay (3-5) has won two straight, including a 16-0 shutout of Atlanta last week without completing a pass.

items.hed: Monangai, Stevenson and Muhammad II are questionable
items.body: Kyle Monangai (thumb/toe) is questionable after a limited Friday. CBs Tyrique Stevenson Sr. (thumb) and Malik Muhammad II (toe) are also questionable. Benedet, Jarrett and D'Marco Jackson cleared after full practices.

items.hed: Diaby is out; Egbuka is questionable
items.body: Tampa Bay ruled out OLB Yaya Diaby (knee). WR Emeka Egbuka (foot) is questionable after two full practices. The Bucs lead the NFL in rushing; the Bears are second. Both rank in the top four against the run.

items.hed: Walker rallies to knock out Cortes Acosta
items.body: Johnny Walker stopped Waldo Cortes Acosta at 2:27 of round 3 with a question-mark kick and follow-up punches, his second straight heavyweight finish after taking the short-notice main event. That punches his ticket toward the top 10.

items.hed: Suarez outpoints Jandiroba, stays in the title mix
items.body: Tatiana Suarez beat Virna Jandiroba by unanimous decision (30-27, 30-27, 29-28), her third straight win. A date with strawweight champion Mackenzie Dern could be next.

items.hed: Elijah Smith sparks Grant in one minute
items.body: Elijah Smith knocked out Davey Grant at 1:00 of round 1, moving to 4-0 in the UFC and nine straight overall. It was the final fight of his current contract.

Sunday belongs to Sol: gold, vitality, clarity and the heart. Old magicians used it for success, healing and making hidden things visible. What you start under the Sun should be something you are willing to stand behind in daylight.

Gnostic teachers said a fragment of living light is hidden in every person, buried under habit and noise. The work was not to invent a new self but to remember that spark. Today, notice one moment you dim yourself and choose to stay lit.

The Renaissance magician-priest taught that sunlight feeds the spirit as food feeds the body. He told melancholy students to walk in the sun and turn the mind toward bright work. After the opener, take two minutes of actual daylight before you sit down to build.

grimoire.title: Grimoire
grimoire.source: From the wisdom attributed to Solomon
grimoire.body: Solomon wrote: 'But the path of the just is as the shining light, that shineth more and more unto the perfect day' (Proverbs 4:18). You do not need the whole staircase at dawn. Take the next honest step and let it get brighter as you walk.
